---
title: Publication manuscript development
---

This standalone Quarto project is the publication-development workspace for
the Redwood Multiaged Experiment. It is intentionally separate from the legacy
profile-driven project in `analysis/`.

The manuscript will retain the thesis as its substantive starting point while
being reorganized around a regeneration-first pyro-silviculture narrative.
Fuel conditions will be reported as disaggregated pre- and post-PCT reference
values, including the PCT-associated contrast, to inform integrated
silvicultural, fuels, fire, and potential modeling applications.

- [Working manuscript structure](manuscript.qmd)

- [Editorial and analytical change log](editorial-log.qmd)
- [Main-text figure and table plan](figure-table-plan.qmd)
- [Section compression map](compression-map.qmd)
- [Fuel-analysis specification](fuel-analysis-specification.qmd)

## Working boundaries

This project does not execute or alter the thesis-era analyses. Future
publication-specific derived data, model objects, figures, and tables will be
written to `../analysis/outputs/publication/`. Shared raw data, utilities,
figures, and bibliography resources remain in their established repository
locations until a stable shared interface is deliberately extracted.
